limitations: Fetch accepts an Otter meeting ID extracted from a canonical https://otter.ai/u/MEETING_ID recording URI; it does not search the user's account or infer a meeting from a title.
Otter calendar_participants is untrusted provider metadata and is deliberately excluded from normalized output; it cannot establish participant, email, account, or CRM identity.

Otter action_items is an untrusted provider interpretation and is deliberately excluded from normalized output; Meeting Intake may derive review material only from exact normalized transcript segments.

Portable provenance exposes only the provider class, canonical authority, connected source kind, and an opaque source-reference fingerprint; provider meeting identifiers, account identifiers, and recording URIs are not repeated in provenance.
Transcript response normalization remains fail-closed for unobserved response shapes until an authorized meeting response supplies private conformance evidence.
The identity-only probe can establish authentication and reachability but leaves meeting.transcript.read compatibility unknown.
